outcome.description: ready when a person could implement the issue as written; needs_input when it cannot be implemented without answers from a person; blocked when the work needs one or more open issues to land first.

kind.description: What kind of change the issue asks for.

blockedBy.description: The open issues that must land first, each with the reason the work needs it. Required when outcome is blocked.

issue.description: The number of an open issue shown in the referenced issues or the open-issue list.

reason.description: Why the work needs this issue to land first.
